zh.title: 雙十連假離島第二波加班機 9月1日開放訂位
zh.summary: 民航局宣布澎湖金門第二波加班機；9月1日開放訂位
body: 交通部民用航空局今天宣布，為因應民眾雙十節返鄉及旅遊需求，澎湖及金門航線已規劃第二波加班機及放大機型，並將於9月1日上午9時起統一開放訂位。
民航局表示，雙十節離島管制航線（澎湖、金門、馬祖）已於8月10日開放正班機及第一波加班機訂位。航空公司已依據訂位情況規劃第二波加班機，其中澎湖航線提供1,016個座位數，金門航線提供2,528個座位數，總計3,544個座位數。
民航局提醒旅客，尖峰時段（10月8日至10日臺灣往離島，10月10日至12日離島往臺灣）之機票均加註「限當日當班次」、「逾期作廢」之使用限制，並實施「退票費用分級制」，依航班起飛日分為三階段分別收取最高票面價百分之十的費用。

en.title: Taiwan CAA: Second Extra Outlying Islands Flights for Double Ten Holiday, Bookings Open Sept. 1
en.summary: CAA announces extra Penghu, Kinmen flights; bookings open Sept 1
body: Taiwan's Civil Aeronautics Administration (CAA) announced additional holiday flights for the Outlying Islands to meet demand during the Double Ten holiday period, with bookings opening at 9 a.m. on September 1.

According to the CAA, the controlled outlying island routes (Penghu, Kinmen, and Matsu) opened for regular and first-round extra flights on August 10. Based on demand, airlines have planned a second round of extra flights, with 1,016 seats for Penghu and 2,528 seats for Kinmen, totaling 3,544 seats.

The CAA reminded travelers that tickets during peak hours (October 8-10 from Taiwan to the outlying islands, and October 10-12 return) will be marked with restrictions, and a three-tier refund fee structure will apply.
